addon:iridescent-lament-configuration.description: A glass-like puzzle box moulded from The Fog itself.This replica differs from the original, providing altogether new powers. Shields the Aura of the Lament Configuration from Survivors who are farther than 24 metres from it outside of a Chain Hunt. "You opened it. We came." — Pinhead
addon:iridescent-lament-configuration.descriptionRuRaw: Шкатулка-головоломка, будто отлитая из стекла, но на самом деле сотканная из Тумана. Эта копия отличается от оригинала, давая совершенно другие силы. Если не идет "Цепная охота", выжившие, находящиеся дальше 24 м от Конфигурации Плача, не могут видеть ее ауру "Ты открыл ее. Мы пришли" - Пинхед

addon:bent-wheel.description: "All that remained of the victim's wheelchair after the fatal blow." Increases the Jump Scare targeting range by +4 metres.
addon:bent-wheel.descriptionRuRaw: Все, что осталось от кресла-каталки жертвы после фатального удара. Увеличивает расстояние, на котором вы можете применить пугалку, на 4 м.

addon:garden-claw.description: "Good for digging up weeds and digging into human flesh." Increases the duration of Killer Instinct after a Jump Scare by +2 seconds.
addon:garden-claw.descriptionRuRaw: Одинаково хорошо позволяет вспахать землю и вспороть человеческую плоть. Продлевает действие инстинкта убийцы после пугалки на 2 сек.

addon:knitting-needle.description: "You won't believe what—and who—this thing has been through." Increases the time it takes for Survivors to remove an impaled Hook Spike from themselves by +20 %.
addon:knitting-needle.descriptionRuRaw: Вы просто не поверите, через что — и через кого — проходила эта штуковина. Увеличивает срок, необходимый раненым пронзенным выжившим, чтобы самостоятельно извлечь из себя шип, на 20%.

addon:orderly-s-shoe.description: "It hung from her twitching foot as the knife plunged into her belly." Increases the duration of the Haste Status Effect after a Jump Scare by +5 seconds.
addon:orderly-s-shoe.descriptionRuRaw: Она свисала с дергающейся ноги, когда нож вонзался в живот жертвы. Продлевает "Спешку" после использования пугалки на 5 сек. "Спешка" повышает скорость передвижения убийцы.

addon:bloody-smile.description: "He wasn't happy after his face was smashed into a tree." Increase the detection ranges of Jump Scare and Omnipresent Evil by +4 metres.
addon:bloody-smile.descriptionRuRaw: Он был совсем не рад, когда его приложили лицом о дерево. Увеличивает дальность действия пугалки и радиус обнаружения выживших в режиме "Вездесущее зло" на 4 м.

addon:coroner-s-coffee.description: "A cup of coffee that went unfinished." Increases the duration of Throwing Spike's push by +25 %. Gain +13 % Haste Status Effect for 3 seconds after injuring a Survivor with a Throwing Spike if they do not collide with the environment during the push.
addon:coroner-s-coffee.descriptionRuRaw: Чашка кофе, оставшегося недопитым. Увеличивает дистанцию, на которую выжившие отбрасываются железками, на 25%. Вы получаете 8% "Спешки" на 3 сек., когда раните выжившего железкой. "Спешка" повышает скорость передвижения убийцы.

addon:party-noisemaker.description: "A party instrument that tore through a woman's eyeball and gouged her brain." Breaking a Pallet or a Breakable Wall with Jump Scare reveals all Survivors further than 28 metres for 6 seconds.
addon:party-noisemaker.descriptionRuRaw: Игрушка для вечеринки, пробившая одной женщине глаз и вошедшая в ее мозг. Ломая доски или разрушаемые стены с помощью пугалки, вы начинаете видеть ауры выживших дальше 32 м от вас в течение 6 сек[5].

addon:sleeping-bag.description: "An absolutely awful place to hide from a killer." After grabbing a Hook Spike while in Omnipresent Evil, Survivors who are within 10 metres of any Hook have their location revealed for 5 seconds.
addon:sleeping-bag.descriptionRuRaw: Абсолютно не подходящее место для того, чтобы спрятаться от убийцы. Взяв шип с крюка в режиме "Вездесущее зло", вы увидите местоположение выживших в пределах 8 м от крюков[6].

addon:toxic-waste.description: "No one could survive being submerged in this poison." After performing a Jump Scare, Survivors within 10 metres of a Hook or a Scrap Pile are inflicted with the Oblivious Status Effect for 13 seconds.
addon:toxic-waste.descriptionRuRaw: Никто не выживет, если окунуть его в эту отраву. После применения пугалки на всех выживших в пределах 8 м[7] от крюка или груды хлама накладывается эффект "Забывчивость" на 13 сек. "Забывчивость" мешает выжившим слышать или подвергаться действию радиуса террора убийцы.

addon:eye-goop.description: "What remains when a harpoon is shoved into one's eye." Gain the Undetectable Status Effect after grabbing a Hook Spike for 13 seconds.
addon:eye-goop.descriptionRuRaw: Вот что остается от глаза после попадания гарпуна. Получите эффект "Незаметность" на 13 сек., когда берете железку с крюка. "Незаметность" скрывает ауру, радиус террора и красное свечение убийцы

addon:imprinted-aluminum.description: "It's either avant-garde artwork, or the horrified imprint of a woman whose face was slammed into it." Injuring a healthy Survivor with a Throwing Spike inflicts them with the Mangled and Haemorrhage Status Effects for 70 seconds.
addon:imprinted-aluminum.descriptionRuRaw: Это либо авангардная картина, либо ужасный отпечаток лица женщины, которую били об нее головой. Здоровые выжившие, в которых попадает железка, страдают от эффектов "Травма" и "Кровотечение" в течение 70 сек. "Травма" увеличивает время лечения на 25% и действует указанное время или до полного исцеления. "Кровотечение" уменьшает прогресс лечения, когда выжившего не лечат, и увеличивает кровавый след за ранеными выжившими. Действует в течение указанного срока или до полного исцеления.

addon:mirror-shards-slasher.description: "A weapon that dealt more than bad luck." Survivors are inflicted with the Broken Status Effect after extracting a Hook Spike from themselves for 40 seconds.
addon:mirror-shards-slasher.descriptionRuRaw: Осколки разбившегося зеркала создают игру света и тени, сильнее сбивая заплутавших с толку. Хороший Парень может видеть иллюзорные следы "Топотка" возле выживших

addon:sauna-rock.description: "Nicely weighted, could be used to crush a rib cage." After performing a Jump Scare, inflict all detected Survivors with the Exhausted Status Effect for 3 seconds.
addon:sauna-rock.descriptionRuRaw: В самый раз по весу, чтобы проломить грудную клетку. После использования пугалки вы накладываете эффект "Усталость" на всех выживших в зоне обнаружения инстинкта убийцы на 13 сек[3]. "Усталость" не дает выжившим активировать утомляющие навыки.

addon:two-nails.description: "A reliable way to hold a corpse's wrist in place." Survivors that come within 1 metre of a Throwing Spike have their Aura revealed for 5 seconds.
addon:two-nails.descriptionRuRaw: Надежный способ зафиксировать запястье трупа. Шипы, пролетающие в пределах 1 м от выживших, раскрывают их ауры на 6 сек[2].

addon:bloody-magazine.description: "The spattering of blood told the story of a brutal massacre." When a Hook Spike misses, all Survivors within 8 metres of the Hook Spike's impact zone scream and reveal their Auras for 3 seconds.
addon:bloody-magazine.descriptionRuRaw: Брызги крови повествовали историю жестокой бойни. Когда железка с крюка не попадает в цель, все выжившие в пределах 8 м от точки падения кричат, показывая свои ауры на 3 сек.

addon:burnt-fuse.description: "The surge of electricity was overwhelming. It left the man's flesh charred and smelling of cooked meat." When a Survivor is impaled by a Hook Spike, the Exit Gates are blocked for them and any Survivor within 13 metres. This effect persists for 5 seconds after the Survivor is no longer impaled.
addon:burnt-fuse.descriptionRuRaw: Удар током был настолько сокрушительным, что опалил кожу мужчины, заполнив воздух запахом горелого мяса. Когда выживший пронзен и еще 5 сек. после вынимания железки: ворота блокируются для всех выживших в пределах 13 м.

addon:deputy-s-badge.description: "The badge of an officer who discovered that some things aren't worth investigating." While in Omnipresent Evil, passing within 2 metres of a Generator causes the Generator to explode, lose -5 % progress and begin regressing. If a Survivor is repairing the Generator, all Survivors repairing it will instead get a special Skill Check. If the Skill Check is failed, the Generator loses -10 % additional progress on top of the base Skill Check penalty.
addon:deputy-s-badge.descriptionRuRaw: Значок полицейского, осознавшего, что некоторым делам лучше оставаться не раскрытыми. Пока вы находитесь в режиме "Вездесущее зло", вам достаточно приблизиться к генератору на 4 м[1], чтобы тот взорвался, потерял 5% прогресса и начал разрушаться. Если в этот момент генератор чинят выжившие, тот не взорвется, но им придется пройти особую проверку реакции.

addon:missing-corkscrew.description: "It seems to always be missing when you need it on-hand." When a Survivor is impaled by a Hook Spike, they emit a 32 metre Terror Radius until the Hook Spike is removed. Gain the Undetectable Status Effect when impaling a Survivor with a Hook Spike. This effect persists for 13 seconds after the Survivor is no longer impaled.
addon:missing-corkscrew.descriptionRuRaw: Он будто нарочно прячется всякий раз, когда нужен. Пронзенные выжившие получают радиус террора 32 м до тех пор, пока из них не вытащат железку. Вы получаете эффект "Незаметность", когда выживший пронзен и еще 13 сек. после вынимания железки. "Незаметность" скрывает ауру, радиус террора и красное свечение убийцы

addon:dirty-money.description: "No amount of money can save you from him." When a Generator is repaired, gain 2 tokens. When you vault a Window or break a Pallet or a Breakable Wall, consume 1 token and gain a regular Spike if you don't have one already.
addon:dirty-money.descriptionRuRaw: От него вы не откупитесь никакими деньгами. Получайте по 2 жетона всякий раз, когда будет починен генератор. Если у вас нет в руках железки, когда вы прыгаете в окно, ломаете доски или стену, то вы сразу же тратите жетон и получаете железку.

addon:iridescent-boat-motor.description: "The blades are chipped and cracked, as if having cut through something solid." Passing through Windows while in Omnipresent Evil marks them for 13 seconds. Performing a Jump Scare blocks all marked Windows for 13 seconds.
addon:iridescent-boat-motor.descriptionRuRaw: Лопасти покрыты зазубринами и трещинами, словно налетели на что-то твердое. Преодолевание окон в режиме "Вездесущее зло" помечает их на 13 сек. Когда вы применяете пугалку, все помеченные окна блокируются на 13 сек.

addon:heretic-s-mark.description: "Those who stray from the path shall never escape ostracization once they received the mark." When a cast Divine Light passes a Survivor within 1 metre without hitting them, they are revealed by Killer Instinct for 2 seconds.

addon:koenrad-s-gauntlet.description: "When darkness threatened to swallow his flock, he led them towards the light." Increases the maximum duration of Divine Light control duration by +25 %. Decreases the maximum speed of controlled Divine Light by -10 %

addon:prayer-kneeler.description: "Suffer the pain of prayer, for the suffering of unbelievers is far worse." While controlling an obstructed Divine Light: Decrease its maximum speed by -99 %.

addon:searcher-s-skull.description: "The skulls of the heretics shall be cleaned and displayed as a warning to others who might stray from the light." When a Survivor blinds you: The Survivor gains Heresy. If the Survivor is a Heretic, they become blinded themselves for 2.5 seconds.

addon:aurora-s-telereceptor.description: "None should stare into the abyss with the wretched devices made by the heretics." Survivors who gain Heresy have their aura revealed for 4 seconds. They also see your aura for 4 seconds. Heretics see your aura for +2 seconds longer.

addon:confessor-s-war-horn.description: "The sound of the horn shall strike fear into the hearts of unbelievers and muster the will of the faithful." Survivors who gain Heresy are inflicted Exhausted Status Effect for 10 seconds.

addon:magnetised-manacles.description: "Those who do not go into hiding will be locked deep underground, far from the guiding light of the stars." Gain +1 Token when you send a Survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States to the Exile, up to 5 Tokens. For each token, increase the duration of Zealous when activated by +10 %

addon:mark-of-the-adherent.description: "Wear your faith proudly and permanently. Let it be a reminder to others that It is always present." While not Zealous, Divine Light's radius is +10 % larger.

addon:undying-flame.description: "The village of Dend was repentant in its last moments, but its remnants still burn to this day as a warning." While Zealous: Increase lifetime of the cast Divine Light by +200 %. Decrease the radius of Divine Light by -20 %. Increase Survivor Divine Light aura reading range by +200 %.

addon:blindfold-of-the-devoted.description: "Those who follow Gerhardt's path shall wear blindfolds, to remember the sacrifice he made for his prophecy." Sending a Survivor to the Exile with the lowest amount of Hook States reveals the auras of all other Survivors with the lowest amount of Hook States outside 32 metres for 5 seconds.

addon:electric-torch.description: "The faithful shall go out in great numbers at night, searching for the heretics who hide in the dark." Increases the maximum speed of the controlled Divine Light by +25 %. Increases movement speed while controlling Divine Light by +10 %.

addon:holy-winged-icon.description: "Clutch it to your chest and pray, lest your heart appear untrue to It." While casting Divine Light, press the Secondary Power button to cast it back towards your location. When cast this way: Minimum delay before it deals damage and inflicts Heresy is set to 0.4 seconds. Increase its maximum speed by +10 %. It only damages Heretics

addon:order-of-inquisition.description: "All those who believe in Its glory are deputized to search for heretics. Trust not even your own neighbor." When Divine Light is cast, its radius starts -25 % smaller, but grows +50 % larger over a period of 1 second.

addon:superheated-glass.description: "The planet of Aleide was unrepentant; after their leader was Exiled, Its Divine Light turned the surface to glass." Decreases the duration of Zealous by -20 %. While Zealous, a cast Divine Light breaks all Breakable Walls and Pallets it passes through. Breaking an object this way causes Survivors within 12 metres to scream and gain Heresy.

addon:chains-of-the-heretic.description: "Examples shall be made of the loudest apostates. They shall be dragged through the streets in chains." While Zealous: Cast Divine Light will always be directed towards you. Minimum delay before cast Divine Light deals damage and inflicts Heresy is set to 0.35 seconds. Increases the maximum speed of controlled Divine Light by +100 %. Increases the maximum speed of cast Divine Light by +50 %.

addon:crown-of-the-destroyer.description: "The Creators saw this and bestowed upon It a crown and said, use this to bring light to the darkness." When a Survivor is rescued from the Exile, for 20 seconds: Your Terror Radius is reduced by -70 %. Your Terror Radius is copied to all Shrines of Judgment. Grants the Undetectable Status Effect.

addon:eyes-of-gerhardt.description: "He rapturously tore the eyes from his face after seeing such brilliant visions of the future." When a Heretic completes a Generator, opens an Exit Gate or exits a Locker, all Heretics have their aura revealed for 5 seconds.

addon:improvised-detonators.description: "Like cowards, they strike with bombs in the night, afraid to let the light of day illuminate their blackened souls." If no Survivors are dead, sending a Survivor with the lowest amount of Hook States to the Exile grants +1 Token. When you reach 4 Tokens, the Generator with the highest progress explodes and loses -20 % progress.

addon:mirror-of-the-creators.description: "And They said unto It, take this mirror, and show them the error of their ways." Cast Divine Light reflects off the first 2 obstructions it would otherwise pass through. When reflecting, it pauses for 0.4 seconds before reflecting again.

addon:obsidian-feather.description: "Some villagers will carve feathers from rocks, hoping that their faith might protect them." You can no longer cancel nor manually cast the controlled Divine Light and it is automatically cast when it would instead time out. Increases movement speed while controlling Divine Light by +100 %. Decreases the maximum amount of time you can control Divine Light for by -25 %. Increases the recovery time after casting Divine Light by +10 %. Decreases the movement speed while recovering after casting Divine Light by -30 %.

offering:hollow-shell.description: Grants +25 % bonus Bloodpoints in all Scoring Categories. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "An unidentifiable cocoon which was breached by whatever was inside."
offering:hollow-shell.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 25% бонусных очков крови во всех категориях.

offering:sealed-envelope.description: Grants +25 % bonus Bloodpoints in all Scoring Categories. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "An unaddressed and unopened envelope yellowed by its time.Its message will never be known."
offering:sealed-envelope.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 25% бонусных очков крови во всех категориях. Личное подношение.

offering:survivor-pudding.description: Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints in all Scoring Categories. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "A heavily salted pudding..."
offering:survivor-pudding.descriptionRuRaw: Дарует 100% бонусных очков крови во всех категориях. Личное подношение.

offering:bloody-party-streamers.description: Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints in all Scoring Categories to all Players. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "A reminder of a bloody good time when people came together, but left screaming."
offering:bloody-party-streamers.descriptionRuRaw: Дарует 100% бонусных очков крови во всех категориях для всех участников текущего испытания.

offering:bound-envelope.description: Grants +25 % bonus Bloodpoints in all Scoring Categories to all Survivors. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "An opened envelope re-sealed and bound with four coloured ribbons."
offering:bound-envelope.descriptionRuRaw: Дарует 25% дополнительных очков крови во всех категориях всем выжившим.

offering:fresh-primrose-blossom.description: Grants +75 % bonus Bloodpoints in the Altruism Scoring Category. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "Golden flowers harvested at their peak.The primrose opens at the very last moment before the sun gives place to the night."
offering:fresh-primrose-blossom.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Альтруизм". Личное подношение.

offering:fragrant-primrose-blossom.description: Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints in the Altruism Scoring Category. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "Golden flowers harvested at their peak.Releases a strong earthy and comforting aroma."
offering:fragrant-primrose-blossom.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 100% бонусных очков крови в категории "Альтруизм". Личное подношение.

offering:fresh-sweet-william.description: Grants +75 % bonus Bloodpoints in the Boldness Scoring Category. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "A bunch of flowers with pink petals and a blood red core.Releases a spicy, clove-like scent."
offering:fresh-sweet-william.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Храбрость". Личное подношение.

offering:fragrant-sweet-william.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 100% бонусных очков крови в категории "Храбрость". Личное подношение.

offering:fresh-bog-laurel.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Цели". Личное подношение.

offering:fragrant-bog-laurel.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 100% бонусных очков крови в категории "Цели". Личное подношение.

offering:fresh-crispleaf-amaranth.description: Grants +75 % bonus Bloodpoints in the Survival Scoring Category. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "The pale green leaves are highlighted with peculiar crimson veins.Amaranth is said to be everlasting."
offering:fresh-crispleaf-amaranth.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Выживание". Личное подношение.

offering:devout-tanager-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Жестокость".

offering:ardent-tanager-wreath.description: Grants +100 % bonus Bloodpoints in the Brutality Scoring Category. The bonus Bloodpoints are applied after exiting the Trial. "Crafted with a fiery, undying passion out of bloody sticks and guts, this wreath calls on The Entity's blessing fore more blood."
offering:ardent-tanager-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 100% бонусных очков крови в категории "Жестокость".

offering:devout-raven-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Хитрость".

offering:devout-spotted-owl-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Охота".

"Crafted with a fiery, undying passion out of sharp metals, ropes and feathers, this wreath calls on The Entity's blessing for more blood."
offering:ardent-spotted-owl-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 100% бонусных очков крови в категории "Охота".

offering:devout-shrike-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 75% бонусных очков крови в категории "Жертвоприношение".

"Crafted with a fiery, undying passion out of sticks, strings and bones, this wreath calls on The Entity's blessing for more blood."
offering:ardent-shrike-wreath.descriptionRuRaw: Даёт 100% бонусных очков крови в категории "Жертвоприношение".

offering:cream-chalk-pouch.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Unlocks the ability to attempt Self-Unhooks during the first Hook Stage: Increases your personal Luck at succeeding them by +2 %. "A small cotton pouch half-filled with a cream coloured chalky powder of unknown origin.Releases a faint herbal aroma. Some believe it brings good fortune."
offering:cream-chalk-pouch.descriptionRuRaw: Дает возможность попытаться слезть с крюка. Повышает вашу удачу на 2%. Тайна.

offering:ivory-chalk-pouch.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Unlocks the ability to attempt Self-Unhooks during the first Hook Stage: Increases your personal Luck at succeeding them by +3 %. "A small leather pouch displaying a straight white line hand-sewn on one of its sides.The bag is filled with an ivory chalky powder that shines under the moonlight.Some believe it brings good fortune."
offering:ivory-chalk-pouch.descriptionRuRaw: Дает возможность попытаться слезть с крюка. Повышает вашу удачу на 3%. Тайна.

offering:black-salt-statuette.description: Unlocks the ability to attempt Self-Unhooks during the first Hook Stage for all Survivors: Increases the Luck at succeeding them by +2 % for all Survivors. "A friable miniature statuette made of black salt representing a woman in a kneeling position offering a gift.Some believe it brings good fortune."
offering:black-salt-statuette.descriptionRuRaw: Все выжившие получают возможность попытаться слезть с крюка. Повышает удачу всех выживших на 2%.

offering:vigo-s-jar-of-salty-lips.description: Unlocks the ability to attempt Self-Unhooks during the first Hook Stage for all Survivors: Increases the Luck at succeeding them by +3 % for all Survivors. "A tightly sealed glass jar containing torn human lips floating in a murky brine.Some believe it brings good fortune."
offering:vigo-s-jar-of-salty-lips.descriptionRuRaw: Все выжившие получают возможность попытаться слезть с крюка. Увеличивает удачу всех выживших на 3%.

offering:torn-blueprint.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Grants the following effects at the start of the Trial: Increases the likelihood of the Basement spawning in the Landmark Building by +100 %, if it is available. The Auras of the Basement Hooks are revealed to you for 20 seconds. "Though brittle and torn, the design is mostly legible."
offering:torn-blueprint.descriptionRuRaw: Показывает вам ауру крюков в подвале на 20 сек. в начале матча. Чрезвычайно повышает шанс появления подвала в основном здании, если оно есть на карте. Тайна.

offering:tarnished-coin.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the number of Chests in the environment by +1. "A round piece of metal which has lost all sheen."
offering:tarnished-coin.descriptionRuRaw: Призывает Сущность создать на 1 сундук больше. Тайна.

offering:cut-coin.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Reduces the number of Chests in the environment by -2. "Two halves of a thick metallic coin."
offering:cut-coin.descriptionRuRaw: Призывает Сущность предотвратить появление 2 сундуков. Тайна.

offering:shiny-coin.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the number of Chests in the environment by +2. "A clean and polished piece of gold."
offering:shiny-coin.descriptionRuRaw: Призывает Сущность создать еще 2 сундука. Тайна.

offering:faint-reagent.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the thickness of the Dark Mist by +25 %. "Paralysed, I stand in the cold as death lingers."

offering:hazy-reagent.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the thickness of the Dark Mist by +50 %. "The Mist is alluring, hypnotising.I love it and fear it at the same time." — Donna's Sketchbook

offering:murky-reagent.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the thickness of the Dark Mist by +75 %. "The Mist seems to protect us from the beast, but it is a poison, a cancer, filling us with darkness and insanity." — Unknown, Notebook

offering:vigo-s-blueprint.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Grants the following effect at the start of the Trial: Increases the likelihood of the Hatch spawning by the Landmark Building by +100 %, if it is available. "A clever design that has the letter 'V' etched on the bottom."
offering:vigo-s-blueprint.descriptionRuRaw: Чрезвычайно повышает шанс появления люка в основном здании, если оно есть на карте. Тайна.

offering:rotten-oak.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Reduces the minimum distance between Spawn locations for Hooks by -2.5 metres. "A decomposing piece of oak in which strange markings have been etched."
offering:rotten-oak.descriptionRuRaw: Призывает Сущность умеренно уменьшить расстояние между крюками для жертвоприношений. Тайна.

offering:petrified-oak.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the minimum distance between Spawn locations for Hooks by +1 metre. "A deteriorating piece of petrified wood."
offering:petrified-oak.descriptionRuRaw: Успокаивает Сущность и слегка увеличивает расстояние между крюками для жертвоприношений. Тайна.

offering:putrid-oak.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Reduces the minimum distance between Spawn locations for Hooks by -3.5 metres. "A ruined piece of oak oozing with a black putrescent liquid."
offering:putrid-oak.descriptionRuRaw: Призывает Сущность значительно уменьшить расстояние между крюками для жертвоприношений. Тайна.

offering:ebony-memento-mori.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Grants the ability to kill all Survivors with 2 Hook Stages once they are in the Dying State. "I could swear It spoke to the beast.It came to a halt, as if calmly listening to the leaves rustling, and then... grinned."
offering:ebony-memento-mori.descriptionRuRaw: Дарует возможность убить всех выживших, которых вы перед этим повесили на крюк, и которые достигли на нем второй стадии, в следующем матче. Секретное.

offering:alien-flora.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Increases the chances to be sent to the Toba Landing Map in the Dvarka Deepwood Realm to 20 %. "Our arrival will change the face of this planet as we know it." — Sarah, Science Officer
offering:alien-flora.descriptionRuRaw: При сожжении чрезвычайно увеличивает вероятность попасть на карту "Площадка Тоба". Тайна. Эффект не суммируется.

offering:shroud-of-vanishing.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Nullifies any Offerings that would change the starting locations of Survivors. "In an instant, their power was lost."
offering:shroud-of-vanishing.descriptionRuRaw: Призывает сущность отменить все подношения, которые меняют места появления выживших. Тайна.

offering:vigo-s-shroud.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Causes you to spawn as far away from the Killer as possible. "I found marvels through the years in The Fog, but only now do I understand how to bend The Fog's irrefragable rules." — Vigo's Journal
offering:vigo-s-shroud.descriptionRuRaw: Вы начинаете матч как можно дальше от убийцы. Секретное подношение.

offering:shroud-of-separation.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: All Survivors start the Trial separated from one another. "A square and washed out piece of fabric with small knots on each end."
offering:shroud-of-separation.descriptionRuRaw: Все выжившие начинают матч порознь. Секретное подношение.

offering:black-ward.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Causes your Add-ons to not be consumed after ending the Trial. "Hear my voice, spare my ways, protect me from the void."
offering:black-ward.descriptionRuRaw: Сжигание данного подношения дает Вам защиту от потери улучшений по окончании матча.

offering:white-ward.description: THIS OFFERING IS SECRET (This Offering is secret and will not reveal its identity to the other Players during the burning sequence before loading into the Trial.) Calls upon The Entity for the following effect: Causes your held Item to be protected from loss upon death. Causes any attached Add-ons to not be consumed upon death or escaping the Trial. "Keep me from evil, defend me, and pass away."
offering:white-ward.descriptionRuRaw: Сжигание этого подношения дает вам защиту от потери your item and[1] улучшений.
